name: Limerence
source:
A short and sweet dating sim that tells the story of a teenage cyborg experiencing her first crush. Play as the socially awkward Violet, following her attempts to get to know her classmate Calla. Will she secure a valentine, or lose her nerve?

[From [url=https://nebuloous.itch.io/limerence]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款简短而甜蜜的约会模拟游戏，讲述了一个青少年机器人经历她的初恋的故事。扮演不善社交的维奥莱特，追踪她试图结识同学卡拉的故事。她会得到情人节礼物，还是会失去勇气？

[来自[url=https://nebuloous.itch.io/limerence]Itch.io[/url]]
